say:6:1810516001:0.text: You... you really don't remember anything!
say:6:1810516001:0.source_cn: 你、你真的什么都不记得了？

say:7:1810516002:1.text: Am I supposed to? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what's going on?
say:7:1810516002:1.male: Am I supposed to? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what's going on?
say:7:1810516002:1.female: Am I supposed to? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what's going on?

say:8:1810516003:0.text: You're Baden. She risked her life to find you. You're her cousin.
say:8:1810516003:0.source_cn: 你就是巴登，她不惜冒生命危险在找的堂哥。

say:9:1810516004:0.text: Your face, your eyes, even that mole... nothing's changed.
say:9:1810516004:0.source_cn: 你的脸，眼睛，甚至泪痣……一点也没变。

choice_prompt:10:1810516005.text: I meant the way he looks at people.
choice_prompt:10:1810516005.male: I meant the way he looks at people.
choice_prompt:10:1810516005.female: I meant the way he looks at people.

say:11:1810516005:0.text: I meant the way he looks at people.
say:11:1810516005:0.male: I meant the way he looks at people.
say:11:1810516005:0.female: I meant the way he looks at people.

say:12:1810516007:0.text: You've got the wrong person. I'm Rain, from the Repair House.
say:12:1810516007:0.source_cn: 你认错人了，我是里纳，修缮屋的里纳。

say:13:1810516008:1.text: Eveline, he looks more like a brother to you. Are you sure you're not mistaken?
say:13:1810516008:1.source_cn: 艾芙琳，他看起来更像你哥哥，你真的没认错吗？

say:17:1810516010:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, take these two living folk and leave immediately.
say:17:1810516010:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, take these two living folk and leave immediately.
say:17:1810516010:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, take these two living folk and leave immediately.

say:18:1810516011:0.text: You shouldn't have come here. Go. Now.
say:18:1810516011:0.source_cn: 这不是你们该来的地方，赶紧走！
say:18:1810516011:0.male: You shouldn't have come here. Go. Now.
say:18:1810516011:0.female: You shouldn't have come here. Go. Now.

say:20:1810516012:1.text: Wait, Baba! What if they run into that thing you mentioned on the way—
say:20:1810516012:1.source_cn: 等等，婆婆！万一他们路上碰到你说的那个——

say:21:1810516013:1.text: Rain! Don't think I don't know, it was you secretly sending word that lured them here!
say:21:1810516013:1.source_cn: 里纳！别以为老身不知道，就是你偷偷传信，才会把他们引来！

say:22:1810516014:1.text: But Baba, we couldn't just leave Eveline and <style="stress"><player_name></style> back at the Repair House.
say:22:1810516014:1.source_cn: 可是婆婆，总不能把艾芙琳和<style=stress>...
say:22:1810516014:1.male: But Baba, we couldn't just leave Eveline and <style="stress"><player_name></style> back at the Repair House.
say:22:1810516014:1.female: But Baba, we couldn't just leave Eveline and <style="stress"><player_name></style> back at the Repair House.

say:23:1810516015:0.text: They'd only just recovered. If something else happened, you'd be here to help them in time.
say:23:1810516015:0.source_cn: 他们刚刚痊愈，要是再有什么情况，你也好及时救治嘛。
say:23:1810516015:0.male: They'd only just recovered. If something else happened, you'd be here to help them in time.
say:23:1810516015:0.female: They'd only just recovered. If something else happened, you'd be here to help them in time.

say:24:1810516016:0.text: You... ah! I brought you to Twilight Village to dodge the army's wanted list, and now you go inviting all these extra folk instead.
say:24:1810516016:0.source_cn: 你……唉！老身带你来夕染村，本是为了躲避军队的通缉，你...

say:27:1810516017:1.text: Bantus has already tracked you here. The village isn't safe.
say:27:1810516017:1.source_cn: 班题斯的爪牙已经追踪到了你们，夕染村并不安全。

say:28:1810516018:1.text: We need to find a more hidden place.
say:28:1810516018:1.source_cn: 我们必须马上去一处更为隐蔽的地方躲藏。

say:29:1810516019:1.text: The <style="highlight">full moon</style> is near. The <style="highlight">treant Hilda</style> that haunts these parts grows angry under the full moon; even Bantus' army won't dare make a move. There's no safer place than here.

say:30:1810516020:1.text: How can you guarantee the treant won't attack us?
say:30:1810516020:1.source_cn: 你怎么保证树精不会攻击我们？

say:31:1810516021:1.text: That's for you living folk to worry about. I can't be bothered.
say:31:1810516021:1.source_cn: 这是你们生者要操心的事，老身懒得管。

say:34:1810516022:0.text: Baba, let them come with us. You said it's safe there, didn't you?
say:34:1810516022:0.source_cn: 婆婆，让他们也一起去吧，你不是说呆在那里就安全了吗？

choice_prompt:36:1810516008.text: Eveline, he looks more like a brother to you. Are you sure you're not mistaken?
choice_prompt:36:1810516008.source_cn: 艾芙琳，他看起来更像你哥哥，你真的没认错吗？

say:41:1810516026:0.text: That means she agreed! Hurry up, before she scolds us for being too slow.
say:41:1810516026:0.source_cn: 那是她同意啦！快跟上吧，免得走太慢，又要被她责骂。

choice:36:0:1.source_cn: 对对对，我们不会添乱的

choice:36:1:2.text: I still haven't paid off my tab at your shop!
choice:36:1:2.source_cn: 婆婆，我还要给你打工还债呢！
choice:36:1:2.male: I still haven't paid off my tab at your shop!
choice:36:1:2.female: I still haven't paid off my tab at your shop!

choice:10:0:1.text: But his eyes were disguised with Graveborn magic.
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 但他眼睛经过了亡灵魔法的伪装
choice:10:0:1.male: But his eyes were disguised with Graveborn magic.
choice:10:0:1.female: But his eyes were disguised with Graveborn magic.

choice:10:1:2.text: Sounds like you know him pretty well.
choice:10:1:2.male: Sounds like you know him pretty well.
choice:10:1:2.female: Sounds like you know him pretty well.

narration:45:18010524:0.text: Thane and Estrilda realize that Rain is actually Baden, but Rain has no memory of it.
narration:45:18010524:0.source_cn: 瑟恩和爱丝特瑞达认出里纳就是巴登，然而里纳却对此没有任...
